name: Moore Threads Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Moore Threads Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the development of GPU chips and related products. Its products include MTT S4000, MTT S3000, and MTT S80, a gaming graphics card; and KUAE and MCCX D800, large model training platforms. Its products are used in AI computing acceleration, 3D graphics rendering, UHD video encoding and decoding, physical simulation, and scientific computing. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Beijing, China.
